findings.mechanism: Retry loop causes request amplification when the gateway consistently fails, violating the assumption that retries are harmless and can overload the dependency (see 04-races-and-atomicity).
findings.remediation: Set MAX_ATTEMPTS = 1 to eliminate retry amplification and prevent excess load on the payment gateway.
findings.arithmetic: With 20 concurrent charge calls and MAX_ATTEMPTS=3, each call may issue up to 3 HTTP requests. Total requests = 20 × 3 = 60, giving an amplification factor of 60/20 = 3×.
